morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不作马来语词缀分析。IPA为人名常见英语读法；本人读法可能不同，不适用于所有语言或植物学读法。资料包未提供音节与爪夷取值，保留null。

senses.zh_definition: 埃里卡；通常用作女性名字的外来专名。
senses.nuances: 实际书写通常为Erica，首字母大写。没有上下文时不能确定具体指谁。本项为专名说明，马来语释义由编者撰写，不能据status字段推定已获DBP收录。以下为自然称呼组合，非固定搭配。参见[人名词源](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Erica)。

senses.zh_definition: 欧石南属；杜鹃花科的一个植物属。
senses.en_definition: Erica, a genus of plants in the heath family, Ericaceae.
senses.nuances: 植物学专名，与同形人名须依语境区分；属名首字母大写，规范排版使用斜体。此处为植物分类说明，并非已核实的DBP普通词释义。参见[Kew植物名录](https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/30249382-2)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Erica akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 埃里卡女士将在明天的会议上汇报项目报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Erica will present the project report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Erica dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Erica sudah sampai di pejabat?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Erica arrived at the office yet?

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Erica dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Erica sudah sampai di pejabat?
messages.en: Has Erica arrived at the office yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tengah tunggu kat lobi. Jom turun.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah sampai dan sedang menunggu di lobi. Mari kita turun.
messages.zh: 到了，她正在大厅等着。走，我们下去吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting in the lobby. Let's head down.

etymology.historical_story: Erica has two distinct naming histories: the personal name is a feminine form of Eric, while the botanical name continues an ancient Greek word for heather through Latin. Their identical spelling does not make them a single Malay word with one origin. Context distinguishes a person's name from a scientific plant name. Sources: [name history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Erica), [Kew botanical history](https://www.kew.org/sites/default/files/2022-03/Botanical%20Illustrations%20List%20mar%202022.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到Erica，先想到人名“埃里卡”；看到genus Erica，再切换到“欧石南属”。这是语境记忆法，不是马来语词根拆解。
